definitions.explanation: Describes interactions, services, or transactions conducted without meeting in person. Became widespread during the COVID-19 pandemic and remains common in business and service contexts.

examples.japanese: {非対面|ひたいめん}での{受|う}け{取|と}りが{可能|かのう}です。
{非対面|ひたいめん}{型|がた}の{営業|えいぎょう}スタイルが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Non-face-to-face sales styles are on the rise.

examples.japanese: {感染|かんせん}{対策|たいさく}として、{非対面|ひたいめん}での{手続|てつづ}きをお{願|ねが}いしております。
examples.english: As an infection control measure, we ask that you complete procedures without face-to-face contact.

notes:
USAGE:
{非対面|ひたいめん} is used as a noun modifier (often with の or in compound form) to describe services, transactions, or interactions conducted remotely or without direct personal contact.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非対面|ひたいめん}での{対応|たいおう} (remote support)
- {非対面|ひたいめん}{型|がた}サービス (contactless service)
- {非対面|ひたいめん}{販売|はんばい} (non-face-to-face sales)

CONTRAST:
The opposite is {対面|たいめん} (face-to-face, in-person). Both are common in business and administrative contexts.
